metadata.title: Public Charging Stations in Schleswig
metadata.description: Registered publicly accessible electric vehicle charging infrastructure in Schleswig; no live connector availability.

steps: Selected Ort Schleswig, postal code 24837 and state Schleswig-Holstein.
Selected and renamed fields; grouped addresses, coordinates, charging points and connectors.
Converted decimal commas to numbers and commissioning dates to ISO dates.
Converted empty optional fields and unspecified opening hours to null; split payment methods and connector lists and removed empty list entries.
Retained the source opening-hours code; omitted separate weekday and time-detail columns.
